target.title: feat(android): add Skill Workshop settings panel
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android Settings did not expose the Skill Workshop review queue, so mobile users could not inspect generated skill proposals or perform the same core proposal lifecycle actions available from the Web UI. This left proposal review dependent on desktop/Web access even when the Android app was already connected to a Gateway.

## Summary

- Add a dedicated Android Settings > Skill Workshop panel for proposal review.
- Load proposal lists and details through existing Gateway `skills.proposals.*` RPCs with agent-scope support.
- Auto-load selected proposal details to match Web controller behavior.
- Support pending proposal lifecycle actions from mobile: apply, reject, and quarantine.
- Gate apply/reject/quarantine on granted `operator.admin` scope in both UI and Runtime paths.
- Add Settings home summary counts and filtering/search/admin-gate helper coverage.

## Implementation Notes

- The Android UI uses a mobile list/detail layout rather than the Web desktop board layout.
- No new Gateway API is introduced; Android reuses the existing Skill Workshop RPC methods.
- Gateway responses are guarded against stale list/detail updates during gateway changes.
- Native app i18n inventory was updated for the new Android Settings strings.
- `GatewayHelloSummary` carries auth role/scopes so Android can fail closed when proposal mutation actions lack `operator.admin`.

## Evidence

- Final PR head: `8c9fb6f212679e0ac223e01562d23502cfa8ca6e`.
- Lightweight local source check passed on the final PR branch:
  - `git diff --check`
- Added/updated Android coverage for Skill Workshop settings summary, filtering helpers, operator scope normalization, stale agent-scope protection, and admin-gated proposal actions in:
  - `ShellScreenLogicTest`
  - `SkillWorkshopAgentScopeRuntimeTest`
- GitHub Actions passed on final PR head `8c9fb6f212679e0ac223e01562d23502cfa8ca6e`:
  - CI run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28929643199
  - Workflow Sanity/actionlint run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28929643191
  - Real behavior proof run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28930668330
  - Latest per-check-name status query on the final commit had no non-success/non-skipped latest check runs.

## Real Media Evidence

- Successful real Android media proof run in `snowzlmbot/openclaw`: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/28934582062
- Uploaded artifact: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/28934582062/artifacts/8165119443 (`android-skill-workshop-real-gateway-ui-proof-v4`)
- Evidence workflow branch: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/tree/evidence/pr-101911-real-ui-proof-v4
- Mirrored media/evidence branch: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/tree/evidence/pr-101911-real-gateway-media-v4/pr-101911-real-gateway-ui-proof-v4
- Direct media previews:
  - Proposal list: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-real-gateway-media-v4/pr-101911-real-gateway-ui-proof-v4/03-real-gateway-proposal-list.png
  - Proposal detail: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-real-gateway-media-v4/pr-101911-real-gateway-ui-proof-v4/04-real-gateway-proposal-detail.png
  - Admin action controls: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-real-gateway-media-v4/pr-101911-real-gateway-ui-proof-v4/05-skill-workshop-admin-actions.png
  - Proof summary: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-real-gateway-media-v4/pr-101911-real-gateway-ui-proof-v4/proof-summary.md
- Proof details:
  - Proof target verifies latest PR head `8c9fb6f212679e0ac223e01562d23502cfa8ca6e` as the evidence branch base, with only proof workflow/script/expected-head files added.
  - The workflow builds OpenClaw CLI/Gateway and the Android Play debug APK in GitHub Actions.
  - The workflow starts a temporary real OpenClaw Gateway from the same checkout and creates a pending Skill Workshop proposal in the same temporary proof state.
  - Android is launched through the normal app launcher, with completed onboarding plus a manual loopback Gateway endpoint, then navigates Settings → Skill Workshop.
  - Captured media proves the real proposal list, inspect/detail content, support file path, and lifecycle action controls from the Android UI.
  - UI XML in the artifact verifies `Create Proof Mobile Skill`, `references/android-proof.md`, `Inspect`, `Apply`, `Reject`, and `Quarantine` are present.
  - Screenshot mode is not used.

## Not Run Locally

- Android ktlint/build/tests and Android media capture were not run locally. They were run in GitHub Actions as listed above.
- Local work was limited to lightweight source/diff/script checks and inspection of GitHub Actions artifacts.

## Risk

- Moderate UI/RPC surface change isolated to Android Settings and existing Skill Workshop Gateway methods.
- Proposal mutation actions now fail closed without `operator.admin`, reducing accidental privileged action exposure.
- No dependency, workflow, release, or Gateway API surface changes in the PR branch.
